items.title: EIP-8141：frame 交易家族的操作码和 frame mode 注册表
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。8141 家族（8141、8250、8272、7906、8288、8312）各自分配操作码和 frame mode，已出现两处冲突：`0xB5` 被 EIP-8272 分给 `RECENTROOTREFLOAD`，8141 后来又把 `SIGDATACOPY` 放在同一字节；frame mode `3` 被 EIP-7906 分给 `POST_TX`，EIP-8312（UTXO）也占用 `3`。由 8141 维护权威分配，依赖 EIP 从中取号。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: an opcode and frame-mode registry for the frame transaction family
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. The 8141 family (8141, 8250, 8272, 7906, 8288, 8312) allocates opcodes and frame modes per draft, which has already caused two collisions: `0xB5`, assigned by EIP-8272 to `RECENTROOTREFLOAD` and later used by 8141 for `SIGDATACOPY`; and frame mode `3`, assigned by EIP-7906 to `POST_TX` and also claimed by EIP-8312 (UTXO). 8141 would hold the authoritative allocation that dependent EIPs draw from.

items.title: EIP-8037：回滚时恢复 frame 的状态 gas
items.note: （chfast）提交，回滚规则所说的“frame 内收取的状态 gas”没有计数器对应，应为 `L0 - L1 + S1`，而 `L0` 从未定义。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: restore a frame's state gas on rollback
items.note_en: (chfast), submitted: the "state gas charged within the frame" in the rollback rules has no counter; it is `L0 - L1 + S1`, and `L0` was never defined.

items.title: ethresear.ch：ecrecover 的后量子升级提议
items.note: 22:08（mirabelenkiy-circle）。许多合约用 ecrecover 验证 ECDSA 签名，面临量子攻击；与其完全禁用，不如让 ecrecover 读取 EIP-8141 frame 交易中的后量子签名：65 字节 `(v, r, s)` 用来编码查找值，哨兵值触发新路径。目标是不可变合约的平滑迁移，不解决 EOA 本身。作者也指出 EVM 把 ecrecover 定义为纯函数，任何公钥查找都牵涉向后兼容。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: proposed PQ upgrade for ecrecover
items.note_en: 22:08 (mirabelenkiy-circle). Many contracts verify ECDSA signatures with ecrecover and are exposed to quantum attacks; rather than disable it, ecrecover could read post-quantum signatures from EIP-8141 frame transactions, with the 65-byte `(v, r, s)` encoding lookup values and a sentinel value triggering the new path. The aim is a graceful migration for immutable contracts, not a fix for EOAs themselves. The author notes the EVM defines ecrecover as a pure function, so any public key lookup raises backward compatibility questions.

summary_en: nixorokish explained that the Frame transaction EIP is now Scheduled for Hegotá, while Derek Chiang stressed that the SFI only signals that Ethereum will ship AA in Hegotá, not that 8141 as written or even its number is settled; he argued at ACDE against making the SFI decision now. nero_eth pointed out that 8141 lets privacy pools sponsor withdrawals directly from the withdrawal amount, with no relayer. A Circle researcher proposed letting ecrecover read post-quantum signatures from 8141 transactions, giving immutable contracts a migration path. AnkushinDaniil proposed a single opcode and frame-mode registry for the frame transaction family.
